x: Held in conjunction with the Open race this year was our first Club 20 Miles Championship and the shield presented by Lady Fell in recognition of the close association of the race with Lauriston House, was won by Eric Gebbett, a first class effort for a young runner, in his first season of road racing.

His step-grandmother, Lady Fell, occupied the Lauriston House mansion alongside. He led a fairly lonely existence for some time and with his weight only now up to 6½ stone many lesser men would have led an invalid existence indefinitely.

We acknowledge in all sincerity the generosity of ARTHUR WHITEHEAD in defraying the cost of the necessary alterations and additions to the 'LADY FELL Shield' and the 'LAURISTON Shield' awarded in our Annual 20 Miles Run, with which ARTHUR was so closely associated in its inaugural and subsequent years.

Older members will recall running around the lawns of Lauriston House when Lady Fell, Arthur's step grandmother, was in residence. On her death the large house was demolished to make way for the housing estate which now occupies the land.
